adaptationDays.reason: Load changes affect only the near term; pace guidance is refreshed throughout the existing forecast.

benchmarkDays.reason: Old maximal results are not current fitness.

minimumEasyRuns.reason: Avoid adaptation from one exceptional run.

minimumEasySeconds.reason: Exclude short warm-ups and unrepresentative samples.

paceChangeDays.reason: No repeated acceleration proposals within one week.

maximumSpeedIncrease.reason: Initial speed cap; not a medical safety guarantee.

normalPaceFactor.reason: Normal training pace is not necessarily easy pace.

loadIncrease.reason: Conservative proposal; no simultaneous speed increase.

successfulRunWalkSessions.reason: Progress by tolerance, not elapsed calendar weeks.

continuousMinutes.reason: Practical capability boundary, never a 5 km race-time cutoff.

advancedWeeklyMinutes.reason: Equivalent time-based route to established load.

advancedLongMeters.reason: Long-run experience, not a fixed prescription.

experiencedWeeklyMeters.reason: One part of eligibility; never a stand-alone distance boundary.

experiencedRuns.reason: Second quality session additionally requires explicit tolerance.

templates.rationale: Original Trainy templates. Mostly easy time with one controlled quality focus; no copied commercial schedules. Progression is conditional on recent tolerance.

evidence.scope: Gradual time-based run/walk; completion may take longer than nine weeks.
Intensity descriptions and conversational easy running; pace is not a guaranteed physiological zone.
